request.initial_prompt: He led the Poles, not into the large room where the chorus of girls was assembling and the table was being laid, but into the bedroom on the right, where the trunks and packages were kept, and there were two large beds, with pyramids of cotton pillows on each. There was a lighted candle on a small deal table in the corner. The small man and Mitya sat down to this table, facing each other, while the huge Vrublevsky stood beside them, his hands behind his back. The Poles looked severe but were evidently inquisitive.

raw_segments.text: He led the Poles, not into the large room where the chorus of girls was assembling and the table was being laid,

and there were two large beds, with pyramids of cotton pillows on each.
There was a lighted candle on a small deal table in the corner.
The small man and Mitya sat down to this table, facing each other,
while the huge Vrublevsky stood beside them, his hands behind his back.
The Poles looked severe, but were evidently inquisitive.
